t2i_prompt: Flat desktop UI mockup with a mobile version beside it, no device frame, no people. Deep navy panel split into two columns inside thin outline frames with crosshair corners. Left: three stacked boxes, each a small monospace label above short bold condensed all-caps text in limestone off-white, describing <CONTENT>. Right: one large box dominated by a giant steel-blue condensed numeral with its unit rotated vertically beside it, and a two-line outcome sentence below. Header bar with wordmark, breadcrumb and status tag; square corners, one accent colour.
signature_idea: A case study reduced to one huge outcome number, with the facts that earned it stacked beside it.
strengths: outcome number is instantly scannable, good for owners and procurement
client/problem/system structure is honest and compact
steel-blue numeral is the only accent
weaknesses: all text is shouting bold condensed caps, not light Geist
green status colour adds an off-palette hue
'LIVE' status and codes are fake UI decoration
brand_fit_why: Palette and big-figure idea fit; heavy condensed caps everywhere and the green accent break the type and one-accent rules.
